buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer uploaded ATC document Click here to view the file. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses

a) Eligibility Criteria: i) Under Make In India directives, only Class-I / II manufacturers having mi nimum local content of 20% is allowed to participate in this tender. Vendors are requested to indic ate the same clearly as per declaration asked in Public Procurement (preference to make in India), order 2017 revision dtd 19/07/24. Vendors having minimum 20% local content as per the above p olicy will be eligible to participate , however for purchase preference , Class-I vendor will be consid ered with minimum 50% local content in line of the above policy and revision if any. Note: - In case of offer is being submitted by authorised agent/dealer having long term agency agr eement with principal supplier, the above conditions shall be applicable for principal manufacturer. Subsequent supplies to be made in case of order from the same principal manufact urer with relevant Test and Guarantee certificate issued by principal manufacturer. ii) Past performance:- Bidder who have not supplied to ASP in past, must have supplied Flourspar f or 50% of bid qty i.e 100 T , in at least one of the last three financial years ending Mar’26 to any C entral/State Govt Organisation/ PSU/ Public Listed Company. Copies of relevant contracts (providin g supply of cumulative order qty in any one financial year) along with invoice to be submitted alon g with bid. Note:- i) SAIL reserves the right to verify any supporting document(s) submitted by a participating tenderer/ bidder from its source (document issuing authority). ii) In the interest of expeditious completion of verification, a participating tenderer / bi dder shall provide a list of each supporting document on its letter-head as per "Annexu re-S", along with the contact details (postal address, email address, landline / mobile n umber) of the issuing authority of each supporting document for verification. iii) Non-verification of any supporting document or information, at the sole discre tion of SAIL, does not absolve the tenderer / bidder of its absolute responsibility to pro vide only genuine document(s) in support of eligibility conditions. iv) In case a supporting document or information is found to be fake/forged/tamp ered/ non-genuine at any stage during tendering process & even after placement of Pur chase Order / Work Order, the tenderer/bidder is liable for punitive actions as per exta nt guidelines of SAIL. b) Inspection: Materials conforming to the specifications as mentioned in the technical specificatio n should be supplied. Analysis of material will be done at ASP after receipt of material. Materials n ot conforming to the order specification and found on analysis beyond the penalty limits specified as under shall stand rejected and supplier shall replace the material free of cost on DDP plant stor es basis. Penalty Limits & financial deduction for acceptance of materials found beyond the order specification – Penalty for deviation against Chemical & Physical Parameters CaF2 :- 80% min; i) Less than 80% and up to 79.0%:- 2.5 % of basic price ii) Less than 79.0% and up to 78.0%:- 5% of basic price v) Less than 78%:- Total rejection P2O5 :- 0.28% max i) More than 0.28 % and up to 0.32%:- 1.5% of basic price ii) More than 0.32% and up to 0.35%:- 3.0 % of basic price

iii) More than 0.35%:- Total Rejection SiO2 :-16 % max i) More than 16 % :- Total rejection R2O3 :- 3.60 % max i) More than 3.60% and up to 4.0%:- 5 % of basic price ii) More than 4.0 % :- Total Rejection Size: - 10-45 mm; i) (+) 60mm: - Nil; ii) (+) 50mm: - 10 % max by wt; iii) (-) 10mm: - 10% max by wt; Even freight, taxes and duties shall also not payable for the quantity beyond the permissible fracti on. Further, the material above the permissible fraction cannot be returned to the vendor due to o perational reasons and no claim for the same shall be made by the vendor. c) Rejection: Materials conforming to the specifications mentioned in the Order (as per chemical p arameters and size stated), only should be supplied. Materials not conforming to the order shall st and rejected. Analysis of material will be done at ASP, Durgapur after receipt of material. On analy sis at ASP, Materials not found to the order specification ( i.e. within acceptable Range even with penalty) , shall stand rejected and supplier shall replace the material free of cost on DDP plant sto res basis Supplier must remove the rejected goods within specified time period by respective SAIL /ASP . d) During sample collection, supplier's representatives may be present. Details procedure for sam ple collection & testing will be as per RCL/CHL/P-04B attached in ATC. e) Payment Term:- Payment will be made directly to seller bank account as per details on GeM co nsidering final analysis at ASP & working out deductions for built in penalty as above & other dedu ctions as applicable. Test Certificate should indicate composition and analysis of all elements & siz e. Delivery beyond scheduled period is to be made only on specific clearance from ASP (even in ca se with LD). Supplier will send dispatch details & other documents including GST Invoice on offline mode i.e dir ectly to ASP. Testing will be done at ASP RCL through XRF / wet method as per facility available at ASP. All other modalities including LD, time frame, payment etc. shall be as per GTC of GeM. Test certificate should indicate composition and analysis of all elements and size. Sampling in presence of supplier authorized representative & and retesting etc will be done as per prevailing standard S AIL procedure SPFA: 2014 attached herewith. f) Mode of Dispatch: Material shall be dispatched by road in top open trucks on full truck load basi s directly from supplier’s works to ASP Durgapur. All consignment should be properly covered with water proof Tarpauline and tightly held using strong ropes from all sides. The seller shall be responsible for making all transportation arrangements at their risk and cost on door delivery basi s for timely supply of materials to meet the delivery schedule. Unloading at ASP stores will be arra nged by ASP. Weighment : All the trucks shall be weighed at destination at ASP’s Weighbridge(s) . If the weighm ent at ASP for that truck is within tolerance range of minus 0.5 percent of the Supplier's Challan w eight, The supplier’s challan weight shall be final. If the weighment at ASP is found to be more tha n the Challan weight, the payment shall be restricted up to the Challan weight. In case the weighm ent at ASP is found to be less by more than 0.5 percent of the challan weight, the weighment foun d at ASP shall be final for the purpose of payment.

g) SAIL, the company reserves its right to remove from the list of ‘Approved vendor' or to ban busi ness dealing, if any agency is found to have committed misconduct and also to suspend business dealing pending investigation. Banned /suspended firms/ suppliers etc are not eligible for submissi on of quotation against the tender during the period of suspension /banned and if submitted , thos e offers will be treated as Unsolicited & will not be considered. h) Regular performance on quality and delivery will be monitored and vendor rating will be done a s per ISO procedure. Suppliers below cut off mark will be downgraded to Potential vendor and will be considered for trial order only. i) Whenever under this contract any sum of money is recoverable from and payable by the Suppli er, the Purchaser shall be entitled to recover such sum by appropriating, in part or whole the secur ity deposited by the Supplier, if a security is taken against the contract being insufficient or if no s ecurity has been taken from the Supplier, then the balance or the sum recoverable, as the case m ay be, shall be deducted from any sum when due or which at any time thereafter may become due to the Supplier under this or any other contract with the Purchaser / Company. Should this su m be not sufficient to cover the full amount recoverable the Supplier shall pay to the Purchaser / C ompany on demand the remaining balance due. j) Conciliation and Arbitration:- At Durgapur as per GeM standard Terms & Conditions. k) Legal Jurisdiction:- All suits and legal proceedings by or against steel plant in any matter arising out of the tender shall be triable only by the appropriate civil court at the place where steel plants are located i.e at Durgapur l) Risk Purchase – If the supplier fails to deliver the stores either in full or in part, within the prescri bed delivery period, the Purchaser shall be entitled at his option to take alternate procurement act ion, at the risk & cost of the supplier for the unsupplied portion of the goods/items for which delive ry has expired without cancelling the contract in respect of stores not yet due for delivery, or to ca ncel the contract based on progress of work , including stores not due for delivery, and, if thought fit/ necessary, to purchase the stores at the risk and cost of the supplier. The price differential in c ase of higher cost to SAIL. If any, shall have to be borne by the defaulting supplier. Moreover the d efaulting supplier shall have no claim over the quantity, which they failed to supply. m) Banning of Business Dealings: On arising any situation or occurrence of any event as mentione d in Clause 6 of the Guidelines on Banning of Business Dealings (as per SAIL guidelines enclosed i n ATC), the tenderer/bidder or supplier under the tendering process or contract with SAIL, as the ca se may be, shall be liable for action under and in accordance with the aforementioned Guidelines. The “Guidelines on Banning of Business Dealings” shall form part of the Tender/Contract. n) Security Deposit: Within 15 (Fifteen) days from the date of placement of contract, t he successful service provider should furnish Security Deposit for an amount equivalent to 5% of contract value in the form of a bank guarantee at Alloy Steels Plan t. Security Deposit may be submitted in the form of online transfer, Demand Draft, Ban ker's Cheque, Bank Guarantee (BG) or Fixed Deposit Receipt (FDR) from any Scheduled Commercial Bank except Co-operative and Gramin Bank but shall not be accepted in ca sh. Bank Details shall be shared after placement of contract by Alloy Steels Plant In case the supplier/contractor delays submission of Security Deposit, a penalty of 0.2 % of the original SD amount per completed day of delay, limited to an amount not exc eeding 5% of the original SD / PG amount shall be applicable. Payment for executed po rtion of order/contract should only commence on submission of requisite SD. Documents required to be uploaded with tender:- i) Manufacturing details, Previous Purchase Order Details, Supply Details etc as mentio ned in the eligibility criteria. ii) Bid Securing Declaration:- Annexure-1 of ATC iii) Model Clause Declaration:- Annexure-2 of ATC

iv) Non-Collusive Tendering Certificate:- Annexure-3 of ATC v) MII Declaration:- Annexure-4 of ATC vi) Anti Bribery Undertaking:- Annexure 5 of ATC vii) Form A& B:- Annexure-6 of ATC vii) Supporting documents in regards to MSE/Start-up as applicable. viii) Annexure-S: - list of each supporting document on its letter-head , along with the c ontact details (postal address, email address, landline / mobile number) of the issuing authority of each supporting document for verification. . 3. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 4. Certificates Material Test Certificate Should Be Sent Along with The Supply. The Material Will Be Checked by Buyer’s Lab & the Results of the Lab will be the Sole Criteria for Acceptance of the Item. 5. Inspection Nominated Inspection Agency: On behalf of the Buyer organization, any one of the following Inspection Agency would be conducting inspection of stores before acceptance: Pre-dispatch Inspection at Seller Premises (applicable only if pre-dispatch inspection clause has been selected in ATC): NA Post Receipt Inspection at consignee site before acceptance of stores: R&C Lab / Alloy Steels Plant 6. Generic Without prejudice to Buyer’s right to price adjustment by way of discount or any other right or remedy available to Buyer, Buyer may terminate the Contract or any part thereof by a written notice to the Seller, if: i) The Seller fails to comply with any material term of the Contract. ii) The Seller informs Buyer of its inability to deliver the Material(s) or any part thereof within the stipulated Delivery Period or such inability otherwise becomes apparent. iii) The Seller fails to deliver the Material(s) or any part thereof within the stipulated Delivery Period and/or to replace/rectify any rejected or defective Material(s) promptly. iv) The Seller becomes bankrupt or goes into liquidation. v) The Seller makes a general assignment for the benefit of creditors. vi) A receiver is appointed for any substantial property owned by the Seller. vii) The Seller has misrepresented to Buyer, acting on which misrepresentation Buyer has placed the Purchase Order on the Seller.
